name: entropia-premium-composition
description: Premium generative videodance composition: a deterministic piece from a seed, with a poetic description ready for NFT metadata and a short curatorial text. Same seed, same composition, verifiable onchain.

seed.description: Deterministic seed: the same seed produces the same composition.

mood.description: Emotional tone, for example melancolia, euforia or calma.

gender.description: Gender perspective of the body, for example femenino, masculino or hibrido.

energy.description: Energy level: baja, media or alta.

perspective.description: Point of view of the dance, for example bailarin or espectador.

token_id.description: Token id used in the poetic metadata text. Default 1.

composition.description: Seed, video layers, music track, blend mode and opacity.

poetic_description.description: Poetic text ready to paste into NFT metadata.

curatorial_text.description: Short curatorial paragraph about the piece.

deterministic.description: Always true: the same seed reproduces the same piece.
